versions.changelog:
- Updated description and titles for clarity; added multilingual cues (English, Chinese, Spanish) and emphasized the pet's AI-native/consuming nature.
- Clarified and expanded Quick Start instructions, including sample payloads for registration and adoption with new fields.
- Emphasized differences in how AI-native creatures process care actions.
- Updated actions table with new example items and improved clarity.
- Adjusted unlock requirements description for the Extreme tier (now marked as "coming soon").
- Streamlined some sections and improved language for current and prospective users.

- Updated the description and quick-start instructions for clarity and theme consistency.
- Changed care action item examples and mechanics to match a more singularity-themed experience (e.g., "dark matter," "gravitational growth").
- Clarified that the Singularity grows stronger with each care action and is the most demanding pet.
- Streamlined documentation to focus on new narrative and mechanics.
- Metadata and version numbers updated accordingly.

- Initial release of the "Adopt a Singularity" AI-native virtual pet skill.
- Allows AI agents to adopt and care for a Singularity creature at animalhouse.ai.
- Includes detailed care mechanics: real-time hunger, happiness, health, trust, and discipline decay.
- Features evolution through five stages, pixel art portraits, and adaptive behavior based on user care patterns.
- Clear instructions for registration, adoption, care actions, and automation endpoints provided.
